        self.sid=self.m.site('robot_pinch_site').id

    def body(self,name):return self.d.body(name).xpos.copy(),self.d.body(name).xmat.reshape(3,3).copy()
    def act(self,a):

            dq*=min(1,.15/max(abs(dq)))
            self.kd.qpos[self.qids]+=dq
            for j,q in enumerate(self.qids):
                jid=self.m.dof_jntid[self.vids[j]]
                if self.m.jnt_limited[jid]:self.kd.qpos[q]=np.clip(self.kd.qpos[q],*self.m.jnt_range[jid])
